ICT.description: Natural vs. man-made; what makes a computer smart; places where computers are used; Meet Sparky the bot Learning outcomes: Differentiate between natural things, man-made things, and machines. Identify a computer, its basic types, and their uses. Recognize places where computers are used in daily life.

Monitor, CPU, keyboard, mouse; connecting them together; basic care Learning outcomes: Identify the main parts of a computer. State the basic function of each part. Identify wired and wireless devices.
